name: microscope-viewer
description: Electron viewer for non-UVC Geek Szitman supercamera USB microscopes.

scripts.bootstrap: npm install && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.test: node --check src/main.js && node --check src/preload.js && .venv/bin/python -m py_compile bridge/supercamera_bridge.py

author: JacobFV
